description: The ALTER COLUMN retype spellings - ALTER COLUMN col [[SET DATA] TYPE] datatype - through the DESCRIBE type cell matched by family prefix: all three keyword forms (SET DATA TYPE, TYPE, bare), with and without type parameters, across DECIMAL/DATE/TIMESTAMP families, IF EXISTS, qualified names, parameterized timestamp subtypes, and all variations producing the same result. Every retype is one Snowflake permits (widening or restatement). Converted 1:1 from features/AlterColumnSyntaxTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE test1 (id INTEGER, col1 VARCHAR(10))
ALTER TABLE test1 ALTER COLUMN col1 SET DATA TYPE VARCHAR
DESCRIBE TABLE test1
SELECT COUNT_IF("name" = 'COL1' AND STARTSWITH("type", 'VARCHAR')) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
